I have implemented the type-safe SQL window function helpers, frame utilities, and `.window(name, spec)` select query builder method on branch `feat/window-functions`:

- **Window Functions & Frame Helpers** ([window.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0ezdti4u/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts), exported via [functions/index.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0ezdti4u/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/index.ts)):
  - **Ranking helpers**: [`rowNumber`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0ezdti4u/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L214-L216), [`rank`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0ezdti4u/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L218-L220), [`denseRank`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0ezdti4u/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L222-L224), [`ntile`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0ezdti4u/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L226-L231), [`percentRank`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0ezdti4u/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L233-L235), [`cumeDist`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0ezdti4u/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L237-L239).
  - **Offset / value-access helpers**: [`lag`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0ezdti4u/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L241-L270), [`lead`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0ezdti4u/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L272-L301), [`firstValue`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0ezdti4u/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L303-L307), [`lastValue`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0ezdti4u/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L309-L313), [`nthValue`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0ezdti4u/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L315-L326) (typed nullable by default, with `lag` and `lead` stripping `null` when a `defaultValue` is provided).
  - **Aggregate window helpers**: [`windowSum`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0ezdti4u/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L328-L330), [`windowAvg`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0ezdti4u/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L332-L334), [`windowMin`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0ezdti4u/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L336-L345), [`windowMax`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0ezdti4u/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L347-L356), [`windowCount`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0ezdti4u/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L358-L360).
  - **Frame constructors & boundaries**: [`rows`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0ezdti4u/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L113-L116), [`range`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0ezdti4u/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L118-L121), [`unboundedPreceding`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0ezdti4u/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L48), [`currentRow`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0ezdti4u/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L49), [`unboundedFollowing`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0ezdti4u/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L50), [`preceding`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0ezdti4u/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L52-L57), [`following`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0ezdti4u/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L59-L64).
  - **`.over()` builder**: [`WindowFunction`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0ezdti4u/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L171-L191) supporting empty specs (`over ()`), inline `{ partitionBy, orderBy, frame }` specs, and named window references (`over "name"` / ``over `name` ``).

  - Added `.window(name, spec)` and `WINDOW` clause generation before `ORDER BY` across PostgreSQL ([select.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0ezdti4u/drizzle-orm/src/pg-core/query-builders/select.ts#L860-L878), [dialect.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0ezdti4u/drizzle-orm/src/pg-core/dialect.ts#L405-L412)), MySQL ([select.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0ezdti4u/drizzle-orm/src/mysql-core/query-builders/select.ts#L789-L807), [dialect.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0ezdti4u/drizzle-orm/src/mysql-core/dialect.ts#L316-L323)), SQLite ([select.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0ezdti4u/drizzle-orm/src/sqlite-core/query-builders/select.ts#L708-L726), [dialect.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0ezdti4u/drizzle-orm/src/sqlite-core/dialect.ts#L337-L344)), SingleStore ([select.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0ezdti4u/drizzle-orm/src/singlestore-core/query-builders/select.ts#L676-L694), [dialect.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0ezdti4u/drizzle-orm/src/singlestore-core/dialect.ts#L315-L322)), and Gel ([select.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0ezdti4u/drizzle-orm/src/gel-core/query-builders/select.ts#L859-L877), [dialect.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0ezdti4u/drizzle-orm/src/gel-core/dialect.ts#L379-L386)).
